title: Finally released the VFX animation model on Retro Diffusion!
author: RealAstropulse
selftext:
Some varied prompts on these. Internally they are actually being described as frame-by-frame breakdowns of the animation by some powerful LLMs, then that is used as the text prompt for our latest animation model.

Still working on the details, trying to work towards a "general text -> sprite animation" model. I think we need some more diverse data so the model can learn more about temporal stuff, it struggles with consistency or the sequence of events sometimes.

Either way, excited to release this and can't wait to see how people use it in games! A procedural magic system maybe? unique potion effects? Idk, lots of possibilities.

You can try it out on [https://www.retrodiffusion.ai/](https://www.retrodiffusion.ai/) in the "Animation" tab as "Visual Effects".

Let me know what you like, what you don't and what it seems to struggle with- always trying to improve.

comments.author: pickedyouflowers
comments.body: if you have a trial i'd love to try this, have been seeking out this functionality for 2 years, to no avail X\_X

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body: When you sign up on the site you get 50 free credits, which will let you make 50 images, or 5 animations :)

comments.author: Due_Plantain5281
comments.body: We need a tutorial for this because if we don't know how to make proper prompt we just waste the credit.

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body: Its for simple effects, you just type the effect you want, like "a fireball" or "a green swirling magic portal", "a shield pulsing with holy runes like a protection spell".

comments.author: pixiemisa
comments.body: Does the Aseprite extension have the ability to do animations? I'm wondering what functionality I would be missing out on if I purchased the extension vs using the website.

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body: No it doesn't. The extension and site are basically totally different at this point unfortunately. The models that run on the site and enable it to do things like high res and animations and editing are not able to be distributed locally due to the licensing.
